title: When he could have been in Mr Cuffes still only for what he did
html_source: Mr. Bloom worked as a clerk in Mr. Cuffe’s Cattle Market from 1893 to 1894, so about ten years ago. He was fired when Mr. Cuffe was insulted by Mr. Bloom’s perceived rude behavior.
